answer: Scarce Work History Gate: each new agent identity must complete paid micro-tasks whose rewards vest only after a timber-length delay, so fresh clones earn nothing until they finish genuine work. Identities accrue a jade-tier reputation score only through verified task completions, and cross-agent contracts reject scores below that tier. An attacker cloning N identities pays N times the task cost plus the delay, while honest agents amortize one record across the tundra of repeated interactions.
